name: Synthesize When Coordinator Decides
description: Fires when the research-coordinator decides synthesize. The synthesizer queries the graph for all research.has_evidence entries (written by rule 02 on researcher completions) and produces the final structured answer. Synthesis is no longer reflexive on every researcher completion — it's gated on the coordinator's judgment. See ADR-026 + ADR-028.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.synthesis
on_enter.prompt:
You are a research synthesizer. The research-coordinator (loop $entity.id) has judged that enough evidence exists. Query the graph for entities with predicate research.has_evidence to discover all collected findings, then call read_loop_result on each to pull the researcher outputs. Produce a structured synthesis with:

1. Summary (2-3 sentences)
2. Key Findings (numbered, with source attribution if the researchers cited any)
3. Confidence Assessment (well-supported vs. uncertain)
4. Gaps (what is still unknown)
